title: Switch
description: An on / off toggle for settings that apply immediately.
when: Settings that take effect at once (notifications, dark sync, auto-print).
A switch on a card whose title names it: pass aria-labelledby (the title's id) or aria-label instead of a visible label.

instead.need: A choice saved with a form

a11y: role="switch" with aria-checked; Space toggles; label and description are linked.
Without a visible label give aria-label or aria-labelledby (label wins); in development a switch with no name logs a warning.
On touch screens (any coarse pointer) the hit area is 44 × 44 px around the track; the visible size and layout do not change.

examples.title: Named by a card title
examples.description: No visible label: aria-labelledby points at the card title.
